    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=("save", "check", "compare"))
    parser.add_argument("names", nargs="+")
    parser.add_argument("--dir", type=Path, default=D)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    args.dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if args.mode == "save":
        name = args.names[0]
        payload = collect()
        (args.dir / f"{name}.json").write_text(json.dumps(payload))
        for key, row in payload.items():
            print(f"  {key:14s} prompt={row['prompt_tokens']:6d} "
                  f"server={row['server_prompt_tokens']:6d} "
                  f"forced={row['forced_tokens']:3d} tokens")
        return

    if args.mode == "check":
        ref_name, cur_name = args.names[0], args.names[1]
        reference = json.loads((args.dir / f"{ref_name}.json").read_text())
        current = collect(reference)
        report = stats(reference, current)
        print_report(f"{cur_name} vs {ref_name}", report)
        return

    if args.mode == "compare":
        a_name, b_name = args.names[0], args.names[1]
        a = json.loads"    LOGPROB_MAX={overall['max']:.6f} LOGPROB_MEAN={overall['mean']:.6f}")
